notes.title: Ninmaki DEMO has now been remade.
notes.content:
Hi! Dear all:
    After enduring various trials and tribulations, NINMAKI is once again making its appearance to everyone!!
    The DEMO released this time showcases a qualitative transformation of NINMAKI, as it will incorporate richer content, more gameplay, and additional puzzles.
    This remake has taken a lot of effort and heart, so I am very eager to hear everyone's feedback on it and look forward to your comments.

PS: If you still have the old version of the DEMO, it is recommended that you uninstall it first to avoid update failure.
